programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Holly asks Mark if she can work on cars. Mark Cain from Bad Boy Blasters brings the crew a huge gift. The '70 Barracuda Convertible is torn down and sent to the dipper, progress is made on the '70 Sunroof Challenger and Mark gets a surprise from one of his favorite actors.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark installs the hood decal on the '70 Sunroof Challenger, Holly helps Josh disassemble the Barracuda suspension, Mark and Daren work on the 440 engine for the Challenger, and the team assembles one of the rarest Mopar options, the sunroof for the '70 Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The team rushes to ready the '69 Dodge Daytona for Tom Partridge and his family's visit. The guys settle a leadership dispute the old fashioned way, the Graveyard Carz van gets a face lift, and Daren retaliates when Mark won't let him sign for deliveries.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Holly helps Mark on the '70 Challenger, Daren annoys everyone with his popcorn and causes Mark to damage a very rare car. programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark gets a portable showroom, the '70 Hemi Charger is dissembled and the team finishes the 1970 Sunroof Challenger. Mark finally reveals his big secret project to the Graveyard Carz team and Royal makes a video tribute to the Sunroof Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the ghouls build out the 440 Super Commando engine for their '70 Plymouth Superbird and install the suspension for the '69 Daytona Charger. Daren finally has enough of Mark's foolishness.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Body man Derrick becomes an official Graveyard Carz crew member and assists in the disassembly of the rare '67 Plymouth Hemi GTX Convertible. Josh and Daren play "the game" with Mark.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghoulz get a massive sheet-metal order from AMD for their '70 Plymouth Superbird. Meanwhile, the owners of the '72 Charger visit and talk about what made their car so special. Daren gets the offer of a lifetime on his '70 Challenger R/T.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It's a Moparween at Graveyard Carz! Just when things couldn't get crazier, Bill Goldberg shows up to go over his '68 GTX Convertible and knock some sense into the guys. He can handle the NFL and the WCW, but can he hold his own at GYC?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Sailing to the Stars"
programme.desc: Solar sails, the latest in space travel technology, could one day help us reach nearby stars. Follow the exciting missions laying the ground towards a new form of space exploration.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Bear Cub Rescue"
programme.desc: Growing up in Montana, Casey Anderson come to love and appreciate wild animals at a very young age. He found a particular kinship with bears. One day he was faced with a fateful decision, leave and orphaned grizzly cub to die in the wild or save it.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Engineering Earth"
programme.desc: A heroic bid for freedom by an enslaved couple in 19th century America precipitates great innovation that culminates in people literally making heavens open. But can controlling the weather save us from climate catastrophe? Or are we playing god?

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Becoming Bionic"
programme.desc: From dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed. Could this lead to a race of superhumans?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "AOPA Summit"
programme.desc: The annual event of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association. We take you inside the aerial unit of the Los Angeles Police Department to see how the world’s largest police fleet helps to catch bad guys and Jeff talks to Red Bull Air Racer Pete McLeod, about life as a high-adrenalin, competitive flyer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Triple Tree Aerodrome"
programme.desc: A look at one of the most meticulously maintained grass runways anywhere at what we discovered to be a pure haven for lovers of aviation and the outdoors. All aboard Fat Albert Airlines, the Blue Angels’ incredible USMC C130T and Sara meets Peyton McCool and takes a spin (literally) in his Soviet-era trainer.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Dream flight of a lifetime"
programme.desc: Twenty pilots attend a T33 Silverstar ground school but only one will win a chance to actually fly it. We visit the Joe Nall event, the “Oshkosh” of RC flying, and Raeleen goes flying with rock stars of the air show circuit, the Aeroshell Aerobatic Team.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft ownership"
programme.desc: Kurtis explores the varied costs and entry points of flying for everyone from the weekend warrior to the rich and famous. When your driveway is a runway, life is good… and as airparks go, this place is Heavenly! Are two engines really better than one?

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Conceiving Consciousness"
programme.desc: Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts, & Naomi Fitter, join Dianna for an exploration of what consciousness is & whether it can ever be understood. Also, a robot tells jokes.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Randomness & Probability"
programme.desc: Comedian Maz Jobrani & Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "Truth & Logical Paradox"
programme.desc: Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right, & right might be wrong. w/ guest Zach Pincince.

programme.title: Proof of Concept S1 - "The Infinite"
programme.desc: Kyle Hill & Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us, & that we might actually be infinite ourselves.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Science on Fire"
programme.desc: This week's experiments investigate how you can burn metal using only a 9 volt battery, what fire can teach us about calories, and why a little bit of sodium can cause a gigantic explosion.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Invisible Impacts"
programme.desc: This week's experiments explore the resonant frequencies of bridges and human bodies, the mind boggling world of quantum levitation, and how to whip up the conditions to recreate nature's scariest cyclone: a fire tornado.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Water, Water Everywhere"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we discover how water can start a fire, transform breakfast cereal into a magnetic field detector, and even change the way you visualize the world around you.

programme.title: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Magnificent Mixtures"
programme.desc: In this week's experiments we mix up some fireworks made from tin foil, whip up a stinky polymer, and try out an alchemy staple - turning lead into gold.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Jerry Miculek"
programme.desc: Thom heads to Louisiana to meet Jerry Miculek, the human machine gun who can fire a handgun faster than an automatic weapon.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Dean Karnazes"
programme.desc: Thom Hunt heads to Nevada, to meet Dean Karnazes, an ultramarathon runner who’s taken endurance running to a level that defies human biology.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Claudia Hughes"
programme.desc: Thom travels to the UK to track down real life rubber girl Claudia Hughes, a contortionist whose extraordinary flexibility defies human physiology.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Tom Sietas"
programme.desc: Thom travels to the UK to track down Aquaman Tom Sietas, who can hold his breath submerged for a death defying 22 minutes.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "The Cryosphere"
programme.desc: New satellites are being launched to continue detailed observations of Earth and its oceans an ice caps, They are finding that climate change is accelerating and they have the data to prove it.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Set Course for the Heart of the Sun"
programme.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us on Earth.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Looting The Moon For Trillions of Dollars"
programme.desc: With NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, how long until some giant corporation turns moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Asteroid Mining: Is The Next Gold Rush in Space?"
programme.desc: The asteroids flying through our solar system contain tons and tons of precious metals, stones, and more. Are the astronomical profits from mining asteroids all hype?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Endangered Aliens: Will Humans Trash Space?"
programme.desc: Sci-Fi has always shocked audiences with images of powerful aliens invading and destroying Earth. What if WE are actually the invasive alien species?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space Cowboys: Who Will Wrangle Asteroids And Save The Earth?"
programme.desc: The next time another huge space rock jeopardizes Earth, will private space companies and their advanced, expensive, and reusable spacecraft be enough to save the day?

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Extreme Labs"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli boards the world’s largest flying observatory, dives to an underwater habitat, and explores a laboratory nearly a mile underground.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Apollo"
programme.desc: Join host Emily Calandrelli, aerospace expert and former NASA employee, as she takes viewers on an out-of-this-world journey to unlock the mysteries of space.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "#StudentAstronaut Contest: Russia"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli holds the fourth annual #StudentAstronaut Contest.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Journey Back to the Moon"
programme.desc: NASA is planning to not only send humans back to the moon, but also create a permanent residence on the lunar surface. Host Emily Calandrelli explores the different aspects of this historic mission.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Tickets, Please"
programme.desc: The commercial space flight companies are edging closer and closer to flight readiness. SpaceX and its Manned Dragon capsule in direct competition with Boeings moves closer to an ISS taxi service.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Mercury or Bust"
programme.desc: The ESA - JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Arming Space Force"
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Above The Law"
programme.desc: Who decides the law in space? And how will it be enforced?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Toxic Space Factories"
programme.desc: Will it ever make sense to use outer space to offshore human pollution and waste?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Suing Our Way To Space"
programme.desc: Cowboy hat-wearing billionaires have reasons for their multi-billion dollar investment in space exploration but it’s hard to ignore how much money they stand to make.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Game Changers"
programme.desc: Emily Calandrelli meets with Scott Kelly, the astronaut twin who spent nearly a year in space. She also visits the LIGO Observatory in Louisiana, which has revolutionized the way we study the universe.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Our Solar System: Fact and Fiction"
programme.desc: Why does Neptune appear blue? Which moons might harbor life? Host Emily Calandrelli speaks with two experts about each planet in our solar system and uncovers some misconceptions about the nature of space.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Space and Art"
programme.desc: Space becomes a rich tapestry for several artists, including an astronaut who once walked on the moon. Host Emily Calandrelli meets with several artists who bring their own vision and interpretation of outer space.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Space for All"
programme.desc: Is space exploration for everyone? From individuals who are deaf, to the developing world, host Emily Calandrelli highlights some hidden figures in this industry and shows how there’s space...for all explorers.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Martian Attractions"
programme.desc: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Cubesat"
programme.desc: Cubesats the tiny Satellites are growing in main stream popularity, they have even been sent to Mars with the Insight Mission.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Proving Einstein"
programme.desc: Some of the proof of Einstein’s theories had long been elusive, beyond the capabilities of technology, until now. It appears that Einstein is once again triumphant with the latest in deep space observations.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S6 - "Space Rescues"
programme.desc: Sending humans into space is always risky. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at a couple close calls on missions that have had to abort after launch, and examines steps being taken by NASA to prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?"
programme.desc: Our long-term survival on this planet depends on advanced satellites keeping us connected and keeping an eye on the Earth from orbit.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Rainer Farraq"
programme.desc: Rainer Farraq is an Austrian engineer who invented the TrixyFormer: An electric driven, enclosed motorcycle, which can be docked into many different vehicles.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Chris Hoffmann"
programme.desc: When Engineer Chris Hoffmann’s daughter asked if it was possible to build a one-wheeled motorcycle she saw in a video game, he decided he probably could.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Jean Yves Blondeau"
programme.desc: Jean Yves Blondeau is the inventor of the 32-wheel roller suit, the wearer who can ride downhill in a variety of positions at speeds of up to 112 km/h.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Dennis Hong"
programme.desc: Dennis Hong is the director of Robotics Mechanics Laboratory at UCLA and has invented numerous new robots earning the nickname the Leonardo da Vinci of Robots.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Recycled Science"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler shows you how to take your recycled junk and turn it into the coolest do-it-yourself science.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Bet You Can’t"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler reveals amazing science tricks that will have you saying to your friends, “I bet you can’t do that!”

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "PVC Science"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler presents fun do-it-yourself inventions that you can create at home, all made from PVC pipes.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Science Of Suds"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler creates crazy ways to make bubbles at the Children’s Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Can You Power A Lawnmower With Grass?"
programme.desc: Andy from the Youtube channel 'How To Make Everything' tests if he can use clippings from mowing his lawn to create fuel that powers the very lawnmower he uses to do so.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 1"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring if household recyclabes can be turned into a lumber substitute.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "Cardboard Lumber Part 2"
programme.desc: In our new series with Andy from @How To Make Everything, we're exploring how to mass-produce building materials from household recyclabes.

programme.title: Silly Sustainability S1 - "K-Cups/Recycled Plastic Into Shows"
programme.desc: K-Cups have made our morning routine wonderfully easier, bue we know that they create a lot of excess waste.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "CUBICLE"
programme.desc: A futuristic designer, Robert Propst, dreamed up “The Action Office” as a workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker’s vast untapped potential.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "BARCODE"
programme.desc: Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China. And it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "FLORIDA"
programme.desc: Florida wasn’t always the Sunshine State. In the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a vacation destination, sparking a land boom–and bust–the likes of which America had never seen before.

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "MAUVE"
programme.desc: In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue -- the world’s first synthetic dye. In just a few years, ‘Mauve’ would take over the fashion industry and enable stunning advances in medicine.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hot and Cold Crystals"
programme.desc: Miners in Chihauhau, Mexico, has just discovered an amazing sight. The Mexican authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews – “Angry Planet” plans to be one of the first in!

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Thunder Down Under"
programme.desc: In the first week of December – the height of storm season in Australia, we plan to travel with Jimmy Deguara, the most experienced of Australian stormchasers.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Hawaii"
programme.desc: We have filmed extensively in Hawaii, filming big-wave surfing at the famous Banzai Pipeline on Oahu’s North Shore, and filming George surfing with the “Hawaian Fire” firefighters. We have also filmed at the Hawaii Tsunami Institute and in Hilo.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Italia Wild"
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Kyrgyzstan’s Space School"
programme.desc: In a country where girls are often kidnapped and forced to marry, a defiant all-girls space-tech school are building Kyrgyzstan’s first satellite.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Ecuador’s Hidden Treasure"
programme.desc: Three women scientists take on Ecuador’s endangered spider monkeys and empower indigenous women, in a scientific area usually dominated by men.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "From The Lab To The Field"
programme.desc: From the laboratory to Africa, Dr Sheila Ochugboju takes her scientific knowledge to Kenya turning parasitic problems into scientific solutions.

programme.title: Women Make Science S1 - "Dolphin Sanctuary"
programme.desc: Anastasia Miliou and her team of women scientist are building a sanctuary in Greece for dolphins released from captivity, the first of its kind.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of the Heinz Factory"
programme.desc: From making fresh spaghetti and mixing the top-secret ingredients for sauce, to giant automated cranes and the latest robots, join today’s Heinz factory workers alongside tomorrow’s machines, making cans of household favourites.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Mr. Kipling Cakes"
programme.desc: Uncover the secrets of what it takes to make up to 5 million cakes a day, including French Fancies, Angel Slices and Bramley Apple Pies. Meet the engineers who keep the machines running 24/7, the workers making all the cakes, and the operators who spend their days with state-of-the-art robots.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1 - "Secrets of Kellogg's Cereals"
programme.desc: In Kellogg’s first factory in Europe, built in the 1930s in Trafford Park, Manchester, we meet the people who flake the corn and puff the rice, the tasters who test, and the robots and hi-tech machines that help keep the boxes rolling out day and night.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Human-Wildlife Conflict"
programme.desc: Earthrise travels to Bangladesh and Australia, to visit two projects that have found ways for humans and animals to live better together on our shared planet.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Life After Conflict"
programme.desc: We explore the environmental consequences of war and how different people, from Rohingya refugees to Syrian scientists, are trying to restore a healthy relationship with nature.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "THE SPECIALISTS"
programme.desc: Within this natural world lie countless hidden worlds, which each animal perceives in its own way, with its own highly tuned senses. These are the Specialists.

programme.title: Super Senses 2: Special Forces S1 - "AIR FORCES"
programme.desc: Some animals have the aerial advantage. They’re the fearless fliers that have the battlefield covered, scoping out the situation with super senses and the right stuff.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "Western Ghats: Monsoon Mountains'"
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are a spine of mountains that lay claim to being one of the most biodiverse places in the world. In the east, tigers and wild dogs compete for prey. All the while, the western Ghats hold the key to life across southern India.

programme.title: Wildest India S1 - "India’s Lost World"
programme.desc: Northeast India is an anthropological paradise; there is no other place on Earth with so many different ethnic groups. The forests are filled with mysterious tribes whose lives are dictated by the rain and the seasonal fruits of the forest.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Tank"
programme.desc: Stacey battles to save a severely injured hunting dog, Millie the calf has been mauled by a dog and the Mark and Stacey work together to change the gender of a cat.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "UFO"
programme.desc: Meg the Labrador has swallowed a UFO, Chocolate the horse is suffering from asthma and Mark and Stacey compete in a chilli eating challenge.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Boss"
programme.desc: Boss the dog has a nasty injury from a possum trap, the fire brigade are called to save a cat stuck up a tree and Mark and Stacey compete in a fireman’s challenge.

programme.title: Vet Tales S1 - "Darting"
programme.desc: Stacey discovers Marama the poodle has breast cancer, Mark tries to save a herd of pregnant cows from miscarrying and the Vet North team dart calves amongst the dinosaurs.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programme.desc: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Working For Water"
programme.desc: In this episode we turn our attention to the damaging effects of invasive alien plants on our country’s water supply. Tali looks at three initiatives, Working for Wetlands; Working for Water and the Water Neutral Scheme.

programme.title: The Animal Communicator
programme.desc: Anna Breytenbach has dedicated her life to what she calls interspecies communication. She sends detailed messages to animals through pictures and thoughts.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Herbivores"
programme.desc: Elephants, thrive on vegetation, though they're not averse to confrontation. Rhinos, resilient yet endangered, face threats from predators and humanity. Hippos, formidable and protective, safeguard their young from crocodiles and other predators.

programme.title: Race of Life S1 - "Natural Warriors"
programme.desc: Males and females of most species will fight viciously in self-defense.Females, can be even more aggressive than males when defending their young. We'll expore the Race of Life from the point of view of food,territory,social status and mates.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Bear Cub Rescue"
programme.desc: Growing up in Montana, Casey Anderson come to love and appreciate wild animals at a very young age. He found a particular kinship with bears. One day he was faced with a fateful decision, leave and orphaned grizzly cub to die in the wild or save it.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "First Images: The James Webb Telescope"
programme.desc: The dawn of a new era in astronomy has begun as the world gets its first look at the full capabilities of NASA's James Webb Telescope. There first images from the world's largest and most powerful space telescope demonstrate Webb at its full power.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Artemis: First Launch"
programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Year of the Asteroid"
programme.desc: New breakthroughs in extra-planetary surveying and rocket propulsion are revealing the dichotomy of asteroids.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Reefs of Hope"
programme.desc: With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Monowheel"
programme.desc: Can Matt and Jeremy get this bizarre one-wheeled bike in gear, or will hey need to put the brakes on the whole thing?

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Panjandrum"
programme.desc: Rockets, 100 pounds os explosives, and a "wheel of fiery death". For the Re-Inventors it's just another day, another danger.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Windmill"
programme.desc: Over 1000 years old windmill design. Is it still usable today?

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Crematorium"
programme.desc: Crematorium heated by sunlight, find out if the sun can turn a person into a pile of ashes.

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "Ready to race"
programme.desc: The Flying Kestrel team heads back to the 2 mile long runway at Elvington, where last year Jon Webster crashed the car. He drives it in anger for the first time since that fateful day but have they done enough?

programme.title: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Record"
programme.desc: Driver Jon Webster is strapped in and ready to push the Flying Kestrel to its limits.The Kestrel team must overcome multiple problems on the day to stand any chance of topping the time sheets and can Jon keep the kestrel on track and break the record

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Search for Japan's Lost Supersub"
programme.desc: The I-400 was one of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Sen Toku-class submarines, which were the largest submarines ever built before the age of nuclear-powered subs.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Path to the Pros"
programme.desc: What does it take to become a professional tennis player? Both on and off the court preparations help build the streght of character and focused mind to take on the challenges of a sport that demands precision and superior athleticism.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "The Wright Brothers: Bravery"
programme.desc: Just over 100 years ago, a pair of brothers looked at the sky and changed the world. They designed, built and flew the most ridiculous of inventions. How did two bicycle mechanics manage to succeed where the others had failed?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Chungungo: The World's Smallest Otter"
programme.desc: Meet a family of Chungungos, the world's mysterious, smallest otter. Living along the untamed coast of the southern Pacific Ocean, these furry, intelligent, and adorable creatures make their home in the wild of Chile.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Living Virtually"
programme.desc: How did the invention of photography lead us to a world where we live entirely virtually? Alie Ward will point us towards a future where we might upload ourselves to the web.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Fighting Mortality"
programme.desc: What is the secret to eternal life? Alie Ward goes from an ancient herbal remedy to arrive at embryonic stem cells and the tantalising prospect of a future where we could be forever young.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Hacking Happiness"
programme.desc: What could possibly link rockets and antidepressants? Are we on the cusp of having a neural switch that can control our moods? Alie Ward weaves a chain of extraordinary connections.

programme.title: Quick Connections with Alie Ward S1 - "Faking Faces"
programme.desc: Alie Ward falls through the wormholes of history into the Louisiana swamps, then journeys on to discover how poker-faced mischief and a mathematical code for winning games have brought us to machines that can invent very real faces.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Aircraft engines"
programme.desc: Kurtis learns about aircraft power plants from Penn Yan Aero’s Bill Middlebrook, whose family has a long and rich history in American aviation. Anthony shows that buying The Aviators’ new 210 can be just as simple as buying a used car. And accessorizing it can be just as fun. Raeleen celebrates women in aviation at the most female friendly airport in the world.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programme.desc: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Cessna 195"
programme.desc: Kurtis takes us up in the aircraft that’s a crowd favorite wherever it he takes it. We spend some time with an ever-growing group of people who use their planes as campers and for one week a year, the tower at Oshkosh’s Wittman Regional Airport becomes the busiest on the planet.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Pilot Training - T-6"
programme.desc: Kurtis earn his wings in a T-6 warbird at Stallion 51 Flight Operations in Kissimmee, FL!

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Stadiums: Stunning Arenas"
programme.desc: Sports stadiums are widely considered architectural treasures, on par with shrines, cathedrals and other important monuments.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Memorials and Monuments: Built in Honor"
programme.desc: Monuments like the Great Sphinx, Hagia Sophia and Statue of Liberty are valued for their historical, religious and national significance.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "City Squares: Amazing and Never Still"
programme.desc: City squares have distinctive characters and often play a major role in enriching and enhancing the cultures of their cities.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans"
programme.desc: Buildings with eccentric and unorthodox designs often have methods behind their madness, and serve to remind us of moments in history.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Typhoo Tea and Fox's biscuits"
programme.desc: In search of the classic British pairing, tea and biscuits, Lord Prescott travels to Liverpool to visit the Typhoo tea factory, discovering the key to a perfectly brewed cup. Back in Yorkshire, he stops by the Fox’s biscuits factory, rounding off his journey with a truly British treat.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"
programme.desc: Mt.Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker:High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "By Camel to Timbuktu"
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"
programme.desc: In June of next year we plan to intercept the Monsoon as it hits southern India and makes its way north along the western shore past Goa and Mumbai up to Delhi.This most famous of torrential rainy seasons drops as much as 40 feet of water.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Hidden Nature"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few hidden parts of nature.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Research in Remote Locations"
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few remote areas to see how research and restoration is conducted.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Science Communicators"

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Java - Land of Fire"
programme.desc: The most notorious volcanic explosion in history came from the small island of Krakatoa, off the coast of Java. The tiny island was pulverized and the giant explosion was felt half way around the world. Java is at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). Only one fighter can come out on top and walk away as the new ‘King of Kickboxing’. Elsewhere, the always exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (72-6, 64 KO) goes up against ‘The Gladiator’ Cristian Ristea (44-27, 13 KO), Hamicha (42-2, 31 KO) puts his undefeated GLORY record on the line against late replacement Brice Kombou (20-6, 5 KO), and featherweights Andre Santos (23-2, 10 KO) and Deniz Demirkapu (15-5, 10 KO) will kick-off the main card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Eight of the best and most exciting featherweights on the planet go head-to-head in a one-night tournament. GLORY featherweight champion Petch (170-40-3, 27 KO) goes up against former RISE champion Taiju Shiratori (30-10-1, 12 KO), the in-form Berjan Peposhi (30-4, 16 KO) takes on ‘The Korean Monster’ Sunghyun Lee (69-11-2, 17 KO), the always exciting Abraham Vidales (16-3, 13 KO) collides with current RISE champ Chadd Collins (63-17-2, 32 KO), and number one ranked GLORY featherweight Miguel Trindade (59-6, 24 KO) faces RISE great & former GLORY title contender Kento Haraguchi (26-4-1, 17 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (175-40-3, 27 KO) will rematch KO artist Abraham Vidales (18-4, 14 KO) and Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade (64-8, 26 KO) will look to avenge his 2023 loss to the always entertaining Berjan Peposhi (32-6, 16 KO). Former GLORY title contender & leading Japanese fighter Kento Haraguchi (28-6-1, 18 KO) will go up against talented newcomer Hiroki Kasahara (39-8, 17 KO) while popular South Korean veteran Sung-hyun Lee (71-13-2, 17 KO) takes on top young prospect Yura Kono (17-1, 9 KO). In addition, the seven-fight card will be headlined by Shiro Matsumoto (55-17-4, 19 KO) defending his RISE bantamweight title against Koki Osaki (38-6-1, 21 KO). In the co-main event, budding superstar Ryujin Nasukawa (17-2, 8 KO) and heavy-hitter Kaito Hasegawa (17-2, 13 KO) battle for the vacant RISE super flyweight championship.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Angling Buzz - Fishing for Summertime Bluegill and Crappie
programme.desc: Don't sleep on the summer panfish bite! The lion's share of panfishing occurs during the springtime when the fish are concentrated in the shallow waters and also in the winter, but summertime can be absolutely fantastic for bluegill and crappie. Just like other gamefish, they can make dramatic seasonal movements and you'll need to find them first before you can catch them. Today, we're joined by panfish aficionado Joel Nelson.

programme.title: FishON! | Storm’s Edge Success: Fishing Frederick House Lake
programme.desc: Join us as we head to Frederick House Lake in Connaught, Ontario, just east of Timmins. With a narrow window of opportunity before the weather closes in, we reel in some fantastic walleye, sauger, and other exciting species. It's all about adapting to the elements and making the most of the moment!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.desc: This past summer (2019), we met a new friend Jason, the CEO of the Catalina Island medical center in the city of Avalon. Jason mentioned that he was in charge of a campaign for the Catalina Island Medical Center Foundation. This campaign aims to raise money to build Catalina Island, a much-needed, state-of-the-art medical center. Jason asked us if we could be one of the big-ticket auction items from the list. We would provide a three-night stay on the stoked on a fishing yacht, two days of fishing on our Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot everglades, and provide fantastic food and drinks when we arrived back in Avalon. We love Catalina, and the idea of creating a hospital for the future of the Island was a no-brainer. We couldn't let this great opportunity go to waste and had epic two days of fishing in San Clemente Island with some new friends.

With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 1

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 2

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: Utah, land of red rocks, how it was called by the Native Americans. We are on a motorbike tour driving for 1,500 miles through some of the most beautiful and dramatic landscapes in the US. Part 4

programme.title: Biker Lifestyle
programme.desc: In 2011, the European Boss Hoss Rally took place in the Pullman City western town in Germany. We show the highlights of this event where nearly 160 V8 monster bikes were gathered. (Part 1 of 2)

programme.title: KTM 990 Adventure
programme.desc: It's very big and mostly comes in orange: the KTM 990 Adventure. Over rough terrain it's often driven standing up. Today, the 990 is considered the off-road specialist among travel Enduros.

programme.title: Kymco People GT 300i
programme.desc: 10 or 16 inch wheels - is this really just a question of taste? Motorvision reveals the advantages and disadvantages of the big wheel motorcycle People GT 300i, made by Kymco.

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We present to you historic image and film documents from the Porsche 550 RS Spyder. And: how the Audi Quattro shocked its competitors with its driving dynamics.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: High-tech turbo cars from the wild 1980s are reunited at the Salzburgring race track. Also: the Lancia Beta Monte Carlo, a small Italian two-seater with mid-engine offers classic car driving pleasure at a low entry price.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1947 Triumph 1800 Roadster provides space for 5 fresh air fans. Also: Le Jog, the toughest classic car rally in Europe. A German women's team takes on the challenge in their VW Iltis. And: a charming oldie, the 1919 Wolseley Stellite.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: With the M3, BMW brought race car technology to the road. In addition: 120 years of Mercedes-Benz motorsports history. And: turbo power in the DTM. The Ford Sierra RS Cosworth taught its racing competition the meaning of fear.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Audi Quattro
programme.desc: Advantage through Technology on rally tracks. The Audi Quattro shocks opponents.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: What's the perfect winter car for ultimate fun in the snow? The BMW X6 M and the Lada Niva have to prove themselves in the Ulten Valley in South Tyrol in Italy. Plus: High speed, adrenaline and pure action at the Snow Mobile show in Austria.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The search for the perfect winter car is still on. Patrick Simons puts the Subaru WRX STI and Audi RS6 Clubsport from MTM through their paces. Plus: With the MP4-12C, McLaren brings a successor to their famous F1 model to the streets.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Jetta is a big seller in the United States. With the sixth generation, Volkswagen wants the model to be successful with European car buyers, too. Plus: we take a look at the new Ford Focus and the BMX X3.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon reviews the Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Below its hood is a 333 HP V6 engine and a 47 horsepower electrical motor. Plus: Upcoming racing driver Chris Bauer at the FIA GT1 championship at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Test driver Patrick Simon wants to take part in the 24 Hours of Le Mans and reviews his LMPC car. Plus: we compare the Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI to the Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Sometimes great things come in small packages like with the Mini John Cooper Works. Also: drifting in the Volkswagen Jetta at the Ice Experience in Sweden. In addition: the Steinbeisser Trophy. And: the Mercedes-AMG CLS 63.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Hosts Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite petrol heads from the Middle East to bring their tuned cars to the 'The Walk' at Jumeirah Beach and have it rated in the categories speed, style and sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a one night stay for two people at this glamorous Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. On this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro and Mercedes SLS AMG try to impress.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: If you want to see out-of-this-world, customized or tuned luxury vehicles or posh cars you need to go to 'The Walk', the glamorous boulevard of Jumeirah Beach. Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to have their vehicles judged by Saif Hattawi. The person with the most points wins a special treat from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the presented cars are a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: People from the Middle East are crazy about their cars. On Put Your Car on TV they have the chance to present their tuned vehicles and judged. They are awarded points based on speed, style and sound and the car owner with the most points, wins a special treat for two from the Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Nova SS, a special Honda Acord and a car full of crystals.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin
programme.desc: Aston Martin are pursuing future success with their DB11 model. Apart from the beautiful new design, turbochargers are used for the first time, but, not to worry, the magnificent V12 remains in place.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: The BMW X5M, Audi Q7, Mercedes GLS and Porsche Cayenne Turbo are among the strongest and fastest SUVs in the world. Sports utility vehicles made in Germany are the embodiment of technical perfection, superior performance and unique comfort.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: Luxury, lifestyle and exclusivity, no other cars transport these attributes better than the SUVs by Jaguar, Range Rover, Bentley, Volvo and Infinity. These stylish and excellently equipped SUVs embody a spirit of adventure and a zest for life.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: US SUVs and pickup trucks like the Cadillac Escalade, Chevrolet Tahoe, Ford Raptor or Dodge Ram are large, powerful and luxurious and exude the feeling of unlimited possibilities and adventure.

programme.title: Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10
programme.desc: The Toyota MegaCruiser BXD10 has its origins in the Japanese army. Its shape won’t win any beauty contests or achieve the best results in the wind tunnel, but this is not really the point with an SUV like this.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Aston Martin Rapide S
programme.desc: Aston Martin is breaking new ground with the sport sedan – the „Rapide S“. Ever since the official car of James Bond became the Aston Martin, this brand has achieved cult status. Desirable, timelessly elegant, 2-door sports coupes are the DNA. But even the venerable British brand does not escape evolution - because with the Rapide S, Aston Martin goes new ways.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The compact cars Mercedes A45 AMG Performmaster and MTM Audi RS3 R are loud, fast and extremely honed. In addition we examine the myth of Ferrari and take a look behind the scenes of the Rolls Royce Bespoke production.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: The Route 66 from Chicago to Santa Monica is the most legendary road in the world. Following the old Highway you can experience the myth behind this former arterial road. Plus: A double-pack of GTR with the Nissan GTR and Mercedes-AMG GT R.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: With its Model S, American carmaker Tesla wants to establish electric engines in the full-size class. For the first time it is possible to attain driving ranges over 400 kilometers. And: with its Panamera Sport Turismo, Porsche taps into a new market.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: With the Toyota GT 86 from J-Sport, it is noticeable that the company's roots lie in racing. The fans' wish to give the Japanese racer significantly more power nevertheless remained unfulfilled.

programme.title: BMW M3
programme.desc: In the late 80s BMW brought a car onto the market which carried true racing genes. Initially conceived as a homologation model for the German Touring Car Championship, it developed into being one of the world's hottest street sports car. Whenever its name is mentioned, car fans feel goosebumps - even today: the BMW M3.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Customised cars from the desert: in Ron's Garage in California, rolling works of art are created according to customer wishes. Plus: Mercedes-Benz transforms the G-Class into the ultimate G 63 AMG 6x6 survivalist's dream. And: the Brabus B63.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: MTM turns the RS6 into the RS6 R Clubsport. Also: Stefan Kalläne pimped a Volkswagen Lupo to the extreme. At the Tuning Expo Saarbrücken he looks for the hottest gadgets in the car tuning scene.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Scirocco GT-R1 from Mathilda Racing, the Bentley GT3 R and the Volkswagen Golf R. The Scirocco is a complete conversion. The Bentley GT3 R is the street version of the current GT3 racer. And the Golf R is the most powerful Golf ever.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: In Dubai, the legendary super sports car police fleet is on the hunt for speeders and parking violators. Also: the Audi S8 MTM Talladega R. And: the Alpina D5 on the race track.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The BMW 3 Series, Nissan 370 Z or Citroen DS3 are usually considered everyday cars. But in the M version, as a Nismo or as a Musketier, things get down to business in terms of performance.

programme.title: Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10
programme.desc: The ice course on Lungauring, the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo 10 in winter training. Twelve participants in six Evos were taught the art of drifting with a four-wheel drive car. We accompanied a student on his first drifting experience.

programme.title: Toyota Corolla Levin
programme.desc: In 1970, the second generation Corolla was released in Japan. The sporty model version „Levin“, similar to the Volkswagen Golf GTI among the Corollas, was only made available in Japan and the United States.
